description: Perocube board/channel status grid — one row per board, one column per channel (slot codes like 'PC01_board01_channel01'), showing which solar cell (if any) is connected to each channel at the selected time, color-coded by connection mode.

options.content: **Cell color = connection mode** — ■ `mpp_tracking`   ■ `short_circuit`   ■ `open_circuit`   ■ empty (—). Cell text is the connected solar cell's name. Status is shown as of the dashboard's **To** time ($__timeTo()) — navigate the time range to see historical state.

panels.title: Board / Channel Status — $tracker
panels.description: Snapshot of every board and channel at the selected time (dashboard 'To' time, via $__timeTo() — navigate the time range to see historical state). Cell text is the connected solar cell's name; color indicates connection mode. Empty channels are shown as —.

targets.rawSql:
WITH status AS (
  SELECT
    (regexp_match(slot_code, '_board(\d+)_channel(\d+)$'))[1]::int AS board_num,
    (regexp_match(slot_code, '_board(\d+)_channel(\d+)$'))[2]::int AS channel_num,
    CASE WHEN is_connected THEN cell_name || '|' || mode_code ELSE 'EMPTY' END AS status
  FROM mpp_tracker_status('$tracker', $__timeTo())
)
SELECT
  board_num AS "Board",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 1 THEN status END) AS "CH1",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 2 THEN status END) AS "CH2",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 3 THEN status END) AS "CH3",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 4 THEN status END) AS "CH4",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 5 THEN status END) AS "CH5",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 6 THEN status END) AS "CH6",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 7 THEN status END) AS "CH7",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 8 THEN status END) AS "CH8",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 9 THEN status END) AS "CH9",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 10 THEN status END) AS "CH10",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 11 THEN status END) AS "CH11",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 12 THEN status END) AS "CH12",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 13 THEN status END) AS "CH13",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 14 THEN status END) AS "CH14",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 15 THEN status END) AS "CH15",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 16 THEN status END) AS "CH16",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 17 THEN status END) AS "CH17",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 18 THEN status END) AS "CH18",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 19 THEN status END) AS "CH19",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 20 THEN status END) AS "CH20",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 21 THEN status END) AS "CH21",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 22 THEN status END) AS "CH22",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 23 THEN status END) AS "CH23",
  MAX(CASE WHEN channel_num = 24 THEN status END) AS "CH24"
FROM status
GROUP BY board_num
ORDER BY board_num
